source: Section 7 Step 3 of the advisor review
prediction_model: Step2 Phoenix original population OLS cooling ~ shortwave_W_m2 + after_noon trained on 11 2023 passes
prediction_interval: statsmodels get_prediction().summary_frame(alpha=.05) obs_ci_lower/upper; individual 95% prediction intervals, not mean confidence intervals
pre_access_requirement: Save dated prediction note and commit it, verify committed bytes before any other-year coefficient file is read
expectation: The three afternoon held-out passes fall inside their individual prediction intervals, and the after_noon term stays near zero or positive after adding all seven. No numerical near-zero margin is invented.
refit: same unweighted formula, original populations, all 18 Phoenix passes; ordinary OLS SEs and residual SD
git_strategy: Separate local checkout of established GitHub repo, matching previous publication workflow; preserve older dirty repository and current export.
